copy.tagline: 理解归因模型与用户参与漏斗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要掌握营销归因和漏斗分析知识。
copy.tagline_en: Understand attribution models and engagement funnels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to master marketing attribution and funnel analysis.

howto.what: 处理营销数据时，会按驱动表规则从事件表聚合，正确应用首次/末次/线性/40-20-40归因模型，遵循发送→送达→打开→点击→退信顺序，并根据数据源数量处理花费字段的正负号。
howto.when: 当询问营销数据、归因分析、互动漏斗或花费计算时触发。

say.text: 按首次触点归因分析上月转化。
say.note: 得到每个渠道的转化贡献。

say.text: 展示互动漏斗各阶段计数。
say.note: 按发送、送达、打开、点击、退信统计。

say.text: 合并两个花费来源，用ABS归一化。
say.note: 避免因正负号不同导致错误合计。

howto.what_en: When processing marketing data, it aggregates from event tables using driving table rules, applies attribution models (first-touch, last-touch, linear, 40-20-40), follows engagement funnel order (sent→delivered→opened→clicked→bounced), and handles spend sign conventions based on source count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asking about marketing data, attribution analysis, engagement funnel, or spend calculation.

say_en.text: Attribute last month conversions by first touch.

say_en.note: Statistics on sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced.

say_en.text: Merge two spend sources, normalize with ABS.
say_en.note: Avoids misleading totals from sign differences.
